outer_diameter = 80.0
thickness = 15.0
groove_width = 2.0
groove_depth = 1.0

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
groove_radius = outer_radius - groove_width

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (outer_radius, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (outer_radius, thickness))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (groove_radius, thickness))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (groove_radius, thickness - groove_depth))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (0, thickness - groove_depth))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

part = p.part
part.name = "grooved_ring"
